description: This file is the main executable for the DataAssetBackend migration runner. It handles command line argument parsing, environment variable loading, and orchestrates the application of SQL migrations to a Postgres database without Docker, including features like dry run mode and migration version discovery.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Main entry point class that initializes environment, parses CLI args, and initiates migration application flow.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsRequest
classes.description: Record representing the input parameters for migration application, including database connection info, directory of migrations, and dry run flag.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsResult
classes.description: Record representing the outcome of migration application, indicating counts of applied and skipped migrations.

classes.name: MigrationFile
classes.description: Record representing individual migration file metadata including version, description, and file info.

classes.name: MigrationDiscovery
classes.description: Static class responsible for discovering and parsing migration files from the specified directory.

classes.name: MigrationHistory
classes.description: Static class handling retrieval of applied migration versions and inserting new applied migration records into the database.

classes.name: MigrationChecksum
classes.description: Helper class providing SHA256 checksum computation for migration scripts.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlParser
classes.description: Utility class converting a PostgreSQL-style URL into an ADO.NET connection string.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsFlow
classes.description: Main workflow class that manages database connections, executes pending migrations, tracks history, and supports dry run mode.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Program entry point that loads environment, parses args, and runs the migration flow.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists.

methods.name: CliParsing.Parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a structured request object.

methods.name: ParseMigrationsPath
methods.description: Resolves migration directory path based on CLI input.

methods.name: PrintHelp
methods.description: Displays help information about using the migration runner.

methods.name: NormalizeEnvValue
methods.description: Cleans and trims environment variable values.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Executes the migration process: discovering, applying, and recording migrations.

methods.name: ResolveConnectionString
methods.description: Chooses and constructs the database connection string based on provided request data.

methods.name: EnsureHistoryTableAsync
methods.description: Creates the history table if it does not exist.

methods.name: ExecuteSqlAsync
methods.description: Executes SQL commands within a given transaction.

methods.name: ComputeSha256Hex
methods.description: Calculates the SHA256 checksum hex string for a given SQL script.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers and parses migration files in the specified directory, returning a list ordered by version number.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Parses individual filenames into migration file metadata if they follow the naming convention.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes version strings for proper sorting.

methods.name: GetAppliedVersionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the set of migration versions already applied to the database.

methods.name: InsertAppliedAsync
methods.description: Records a successfully applied migration into the history table.

methods.name: ToAdoLikeConnectionString
methods.description: Converts a postgres:// URL into an ADO.NET connection string for Npgsql.
